feature: The lists pane holds still under the pointer
summary: The pane at the foot of the panel holding Layers and the Library now keeps its height while you work in it. Folding a list or switching the Library from Media to Comps no longer moves the header or control you just clicked, so a second click on the same spot lands.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. A picture open (File > New, 1440 by 900 window works well), nothing picked.

try.do: Look at the foot of the right panel: Layers, and under it the Library on Media.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click Comps in the Library's Media, Comps, Styles, Systems control, then click Media without moving the mouse sideways more than the gap between them.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click the Layers header to fold Layers, then click it again on the same spot to open it.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click the Library header twice on the same spot: it folds and opens again.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Drag the line above the pane up and down: it goes as tall as you like, short of the pick's last 160 points, whatever its lists hold.

evaluate: With Layers folded, does the empty glass at the foot of the pane read as room the pane keeps, or as something missing?
Is it right that the pane only changes height when you drag its line or resize the window, never when a list folds?
Does the pane start at a height you would leave it at, before you ever drag its line?
rough: No mock draws the lists pane: it comes from your answer B to 'Where do Layers and Library sit when something is picked?' on 2026-10-13 ('keeps its height'), so there is no mock frame to set beside it.
Short or folded lists now leave plain glass at the foot of the pane instead of giving that room to the pick, the way a Photoshop panel keeps its size. Dragging the line down gives the room back.

Before you touch the line, the pane now starts tall enough for every list in it at its least (Layers three rows, a whole row of Library tiles), up to half the panel, whatever those lists hold right now. On a 1440 by 900 window with Layers and the Library that is about half the panel, which is what the old pane gave any document whose lists were full.
The pane still works its height out again when the window changes height or a list joins it (Measurements, after the first measurement), since the pointer is not in the pane for either.

A height you set by dragging the line before this change was capped by what the lists held; it is now taken as it was stored, so if you had dragged it all the way up the pane opens tall once. Drag it down once and it stays.

One run of section-fold-motion-walk failed once at its video step (Speed not found after Time was filmed opening) and passed on three runs after; the pane holds nothing on a video, so I logged it as a flake rather than filing it.
